name: UT Zendesk
description: Unit tests of every Zendesk command against the local stand-in (made-up records, made-up token from the vault): each case shows the command in use and checks its result.

variables.name: ut_dir
variables.description: Folder with the test data (files, workbooks, fixtures).

variables.name: standin_url
variables.description: Address of the local stand-in that imitates outside services.

variables.name: ut_report
variables.description: One line per case: PASS or FAIL, the command and the case.

args.text: Unit tests of every Zendesk command against the local stand-in (made-up records, made-up token from the vault): each case shows the command in use and checks its result.

args.title: 1. ooa.zendesk/connect - sign in with a saved connection

args.text: Connect picks a saved connection (site, agent email and API token from the vault); the later Zendesk steps leave site and sign-in empty and use it. The case saves the connection in the run folder first. Checks the connection's name comes back.

else.description: Stop the case: the check failed

args.value: ${ut_report}PASS  ooa.zendesk/connect: sign in with a saved connection

children.description: Add a PASS line to the report
Run the command and check what it gave back
